newsitem.title: POLAND: Pope praises shared Jewish heritage with Poles.
newsitem.headline: Pope praises shared Jewish heritage with Poles.

text.p: Pope John Paul on Wednesday paid tribute to Jews, millions of whom died in Nazi concentration camps in Poland, and praised their common heritage with Poles in his homeland.
Visiting a sanctuary in Kalisz dedicated to Polish clergy who survived the World War Two death camp at Dachau in Germany, he spoke at a mass of the relationship between Jews and Poles.
The 77-year-old Pontiff described German extermination camps on Polish soil as "places of execution which fill us with terror" and added:
"A people who lived with us for many generations remained with us after this terrible death of millions of daughters and sons. Jewish cemeteries scattered around Poland testify to this common past."
